title: Call Centre Agent
description:
EE Merthyr Tydfil Contact Centre - Full-time role - 37.5 Hours per week

If you're outgoing, full of energy and love talking to people, you'd be better off in sales with EE.

Maybe you've worked in retail, or hospitality before. You know how to deal with customers but you're looking for something more exciting - a job that's going to challenge you. And, of course, you want to earn a bit more cash.

Our team in Merthyr is full of people like you - so you'll be in great company here.

What does being a sales advisor involve?

You'll join a lively sales team in our Merthyr contact centre. We'll train you to take incoming calls from existing EE customers and help them find the best deals on their phones and broadband. You'll also help them to navigate the different tech products we sell.

You need to be a great listener as well as a fluent talker. A lot of the time, you'll pick up on something that someone has said, then use that to match them with the perfect product.

Forget what you've heard about sales

Don't let what you've heard about sales put you off. Let's smash a few myths
- Yes, there are targets to hit. But the kind of people who like sales, love that. You're probably naturally competitive. You get a buzz out of beating the person next to you. You hate being bored at work.
- It's not "cold calling". The calls come in to you and you decide how best you can help the customer. That's why we value resourceful people who like fixing problems.
- People say it's "hard selling". It's really not! You're basically talking to people about fun tech stuff that they already want. Who doesn't love a better phone, faster broadband or a new console?

Why you'll be better off at EE

GREAT MONEY - you start on £26,116 which goes up to £26,738 after 8 months.

UNCAPPED COMMISSION - the more you sell, the more you can earn.

BRILLIANT BENEFITS - including 24/7 GP appointments for you and your family, free parking and discounts on EE products like phones and broadband that could save you £100s every year.

GROWTH - we're passionate about developing our people. There are plenty of career paths across EE and BT.

FLEXIBILITY - you can bank hours then take time off when you need. Plus, generous leave for carers and anyone starting a family.

GREAT PEOPLE - you're working with people like you. It's a sociable, supportive environment.

title: BMW Service Advisor
description:
About the role

We have an excellent opportunity available for a motivated Service Advisor to join our team at Sytner BMW Cardiff.

As a Sytner Service Advisor, you will provide outstanding customer care and be the vital link between our customers and the workshop. You will inform and consult on vehicle servicing, and keep the customer up to date at every stage whilst answering any questions or queries they may have. You will also liaise with technicians/workshop control about vehicle statuses and ensure that vehicles will be ready on time. You will also have the ability to give the best advice on our products and services to our customers.

This is a challenging role where customer care always comes first, you'll take the time to talk to people, build a genuine rapport and identify exactly what our customers want and need.

Sytner Service Advisors work a variety of flexible patterns which can typically include weekends to ensure we provide our customers with the highest possible levels of service.

About you

Don't worry if you do not have previous experience, we want applications from individuals with a willingness to learn and progress. Training is provided through our dedicated in-house Learning & Development team and outstanding manufacturer courses run by BMW to support your career.

Ideally, you will have excellent organisational and administrative skills along with good attention to detail. A strong customer service background would be beneficial as you will be delivering high levels of customer satisfaction in a very busy and demanding environment. Working knowledge of Kerridge would be advantageous, but not essential.

Why Sytner?

Sytner Group are delighted to provide an industry-leading benefits package.

We are passionate about continuous improvement and building an environment where everyone feels valued, appreciated and able to reach their full potential.
- Enhanced Holiday Entitlement - 33 days inc. bank holidays
- Industry-leading Maternity, Paternity and Adoption Pay
- Career Development
- Recognition of Long Service every 5 years
- Discounted Car Schemes
- High Street Discounts
- Discounted Gym memberships
- Cycle to work scheme
- One day a year paid voluntary / community work

At Sytner, our values and the way we behave are important to us. We are committed to creating an equitable working environment where we value and respect every individual's unique contribution, supporting our colleagues to thrive and achieve their full potential.

As part of our commitment to Diversity and Inclusion, you have the right to ask for changes / adjustments to job interviews and the recruitment process. For more information around reasonable adjustments and the recruitment process please .

Unsure? Read on

We represent over 23 of the world's most prestige vehicle brands, across our 140 UK dealerships.

We pride ourselves on 'Developing Talent and 'Building Careers' and our colleagues recently scored Sytner Group an outstanding 89% on our colleague engagement survey.

title: Finance Assistant
description:
Finance Administrator

Cardiff City Centre Hybrid Working £28,000

We're delighted to be supporting a high-growth, private equity-backed service business in Cardiff with the appointment of a Finance Administrator.

This is an exciting opportunity to join a growing organisation at an important stage of its development. Reporting into the finance team, you'll have the opportunity to gain broad exposure across the function and develop your skills within a fast-paced and commercially focused environment.

The opportunity

As Finance Administrator, you'll support the smooth running of the day-to-day finance function, working closely with the wider finance team and colleagues across the business.

Your responsibilities will include:
- Processing sales and purchase invoices
- Maintaining accurate financial records and finance systems
- Supporting accounts payable and accounts receivable
- Allocating and reconciling payments
- Assisting with bank reconciliations
- Supporting credit control and dealing with customer queries
- Processing employee expenses
- Assisting with month-end activities
- Preparing finance information and reports
- Responding to finance-related queries from internal and external stakeholders
- Supporting the wider finance team with ad-hoc tasks and process improvements

About you

We're looking for an organised and detail-focused individual who is keen to build a career in finance.

You may already have experience in a finance administration, accounts or transactional finance role, or you could be looking to take the next step following a relevant qualification or study.

You'll need:
- Previous experience within a finance or accounts environment
- Strong attention to detail and accuracy
- Good numerical and analytical skills
- Good working knowledge of Excel
- Excellent organisation and time management
- Strong communication skills
- A proactive attitude and willingness to learn
- The ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a team

AAT study or experience with accounting software would be advantageous, but is not essential.

What's in it for you?
- £28,000 salary
- Hybrid working
- Cardiff city centre location
- Opportunity to join a growing, PE-backed business
- Broad exposure across the finance function
- Support and development from an experienced finance team
- Excellent opportunity to develop your finance career
- A varied role within an ambitious and evolving organisation

If you're looking for a role where you can develop your finance experience, gain exposure to a growing business and build a long-term career, this could be an excellent opportunity.

Robert Half Ltd acts as an employment business for temporary positions and an employment agency for permanent positions. Robert Half is committed to diversity, equity and inclusion. Suitable candidates with equivalent qualifications and more or less experience can apply. Rates of pay and salary ranges are dependent upon your experience, qualifications and training. title: Accounts Assistant
description:
Accounts Assistant

Up to £30,000 DOE + Excellent Benefits

Cardiff

Môrwell Talent Solutions are delighted to be working with a growing and successful manufacturing business based on the outskirts of Cardiff. This is a fantastic opportunity for an enthusiastic and hardworking Accounts Assistant to join a friendly and supportive finance team within an organisation that genuinely invests in and values its people.

The business is continuing to grow, and they are looking for someone who is keen to develop their career within finance and build a long-term future with the organisation. Ideally, you will be AAT qualified or studying towards AAT, or at the early stages of ACCA or CIMA, with some previous experience within an accounts or finance environment. What makes this opportunity particularly appealing is the scope to learn, develop and take on additional responsibility over time. They are looking for someone with the right attitude and willingness to learn, who can grow alongside the business.

The Role

Working as part of the wider finance function, you will provide support across a broad range of accounting activities, including:

Sales Ledger
- Generating sales invoices.
- Supporting credit control and liaising with customers regarding outstanding payments.
- Allocating customer receipts.
- Assisting with month-end sales ledger routines and ensuring reporting is completed accurately and on time.

Purchase Ledger
- Matching purchase orders and delivery notes to purchase invoices.
- Inputting and processing invoices onto the finance system.
- Allocating supplier payments and completing statement reconciliations.
- Dealing with supplier queries.
- Assisting with month-end purchase ledger routines

General Finance
- Maintaining accurate financial records and filing systems.
- Assisting with bank and account reconciliations.
- Supporting month-end processes and financial reporting.
- Assisting with payroll administration when required.
- Responding to finance-related queries from internal departments.
- Supporting audits and ensuring company procedures are followed.
- Assisting with ad hoc accounting and administrative duties across the finance team.
- Assisting with quarterly VAT returns.

About You

We're looking for someone who is enthusiastic about developing their career within finance and who enjoys being part of a team.

Ideally, you will have:
- Previous experience within an accounts, finance or relevant administrative role.
- AAT qualified/studying or working towards ACCA/CIMA - ideally at the early stages of your qualification.
- A good understanding of basic accounting principles.
- Strong numerical and analytical skills.
- Excellent attention to detail and accuracy.
- Good working knowledge of Microsoft Excel and finance/accounting systems.
- Strong organisational and communication skills.
- The ability to manage your workload and meet deadlines.
- A positive, proactive and hardworking approach.
- A genuine willingness to learn and develop.
- The ability to work both independently and as part of a wider team.

Most importantly, we're looking for the right attitude. You don't need to know everything from day one. This is an organisation that will support and nurture the right person, providing opportunities to develop your skills and take on more responsibility as your experience grows.

What's on Offer?
- 37.5 hours per week, with flexibility around start time up to 8.30am.
- Friday early finish
- 24 days' annual leave + 8 Bank Holidays. Additional birthday day off.
- Company Christmas shutdown, including additional company-funded days off.
- Workplace pension
- Life assurance
- Discretionary annual bonus scheme.
- Full support and encouragement for professional and continuous development.
- Regular company team events, including summer and Christmas celebrations.
- A friendly, supportive working environment where your contribution is valued.
- This is an office-based role and does not currently offer home working.

Interested?

If you're looking for an opportunity where you can build your finance career, gain broader accounting experience and develop alongside a growing business, we'd love to hear from you. Môrwell Talent Solutions are managing this opportunity exclusively and would be happy to have a confidential conversation with you about the role.

title: Accounts Assistant
description:
Accounts Assistant

Location: Cardiff (Fully Site-Based)
Hours: Monday to Friday, 9:00am - 5:00pm
Salary: £27,000 per annum

The Opportunity

We are currently recruiting for an Accounts Assistant to join a friendly and supportive team based in Cardiff. This is an excellent opportunity for someone with previous accounts experience who is looking to further develop their skills and build a long-term career within finance.

The successful candidate will join a positive working environment that encourages professional development and offers plenty of opportunities to learn, grow, and progress within the business.

Key Responsibilities
- Processing purchase ledger invoices accurately and efficiently
- Matching, checking, and coding invoices
- Assisting with payment runs and supplier statements
- Reconciling supplier accounts and resolving queries
- Supporting sales ledger and invoicing activities
- Maintaining accurate financial records and account information
- Assisting with month-end processes and reporting
- Liaising with suppliers and internal departments regarding account queries
- General finance administration duties as required

About You
- Previous experience within an Accounts Assistant, Finance Assistant, Purchase Ledger Clerk, or similar role
- Good understanding of purchase ledger and invoicing processes
- Strong attention to detail and accuracy
- Excellent organisational and time management skills
- Confident using Microsoft Office, particularly Excel
- Strong communication skills and a proactive approach to work
- Eager to learn, develop new skills, and progress within a finance career

Benefits
- 25 days annual leave plus bank holidays
- Excellent opportunities for training, development, and career progression
- Supportive and collaborative team environment
- Regular company social events
- Employee discounts and benefits scheme

If you are looking to join a welcoming team where your contribution is valued and your career development is encouraged, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Receptionist
description: Danescourt & Greenmount Surgery is looking to recruit a friendly, organised and reliable Receptionist to join our busy GP practice team. This is a key front-facing role within the practice. The successful candidate will be the first point of contact for patients and visitors, providing a professional, welcoming and efficient reception service while supporting the clinical and administrative teams. We are currently flexible regarding full-time or part-time hours and are primarily looking for the right person who will fit well within our team and provide excellent patient care. Reception Duties Greet patients and visitors in a courteous and professional manner Book, amend and cancel patient appointments using the practice clinical system Direct patients to the appropriate clinician or service Answer incoming calls promptly and deal with enquiries efficiently Signpost patients to the appropriate service where necessary Take accurate messages and pass them to relevant team members Maintain accurate patient records Scan and file clinical correspondence and documents Process incoming and outgoing post Work collaboratively with colleagues to maintain smooth day-to-day running of the practice Participate in training and team meetings when required Follow all practice policies, procedures, and NHS guidance Job Description Job Title: Receptionist Location: Danescourt & Greenmount Surgery Reports To: Practice Manager / Reception Supervisor Hours: Full-time or Part-time (negotiable) Salary: Dependent on experience To provide an efficient, professional and friendly reception and administrative service to patients and visitors at Danescourt & Greenmount Surgery. The post holder will act as the first point of contact for patients, supporting the smooth running of the practice by managing appointments, handling enquiries and carrying out administrative duties while ensuring a high standard of patient care and confidentiality. Welcome patients and visitors to the practice in a polite and professional manner. Book, amend and cancel patient appointments in accordance with practice procedures. Ensure patients are directed to the appropriate healthcare professional or service. Register new patients and update patient information on the clinical system. Ensure the reception area remains tidy and welcoming at all times. Answer incoming telephone calls promptly and deal with patient enquiries efficiently. Signpost patients to the most appropriate service where necessary. Take and pass on clear and accurate messages to clinical staff and colleagues. Deal with general patient enquiries both in person and over the telephone. Maintain accurate patient records and ensure information is updated appropriately. Scan, file and distribute incoming correspondence and documentation. Process incoming and outgoing post. Support the clinical and administrative teams with general administrative tasks when required. Maintain strict patient confidentiality at all times. Ensure compliance with data protection legislation and practice policies. Handle sensitive information with discretion and professionalism. Work collaboratively with all members of the practice team. Support colleagues and assist in maintaining an efficient working environment. Participate in staff meetings, training sessions and practice development activities as required.
